# KiTee Studio

> KiTee Studio is a boutique digital products studio that builds downloadable
> utility apps and premium one-page website templates. Every product is a
> single self-contained file: buy once, download, and own it forever. No
> subscriptions, no accounts, no hosting required. Built by a neurodivergent
> founder, with tools designed specifically for AuDHD and neurodivergent
> brains alongside general-purpose products for coaches, freelancers,
> authors, podcasters, personal trainers, and makers.

## About

- Founder: Tarrah, an AuDHD founder and builder based in the UK.
- Positioning: practical, no-fluff tools that solve one real problem well,
  not bloated all-in-one platforms.
- Every website template ships with SiteFill™, a built-in visual editor —
  buyers fill in their own content directly in the browser and download a
  finished, ready-to-publish HTML file. No code, no page builder account.
- Every utility app is a single offline HTML file: open it in any browser,
  on any device, and it works with no internet connection and no login.

## Utility Apps

- Burnout Recovery Blueprint (/products/burnout-recovery-blueprint) — track
  energy, identify burnout stage, build a recovery plan. Built for AuDHD
  and neurodivergent brains.
- Post-Diagnosis Rebuild Kit (/products/post-diagnosis-rebuild-kit) — a
  guided tool for processing a late AuDHD diagnosis and rebuilding identity.
- Gym Tracker (/products/gym-tracker) — offline workout and personal-record
  tracker, no subscription.

## SiteFill™ Website Templates

- Life Coach (/products/life-coach-website-template)
- Freelancer (/products/freelancer-website-template)
- Author (/products/author-website-template) and Author Premium
  (/products/author-premium-template)
- Podcast (/products/podcast-website-template)
- Shop & Artisan (/products/shop-website-template)
- Personal Trainer (/products/personal-trainer-website-template) and
  Personal Trainer Premium (/products/personal-trainer-premium-template)

## Key facts

- All products are one-time purchases. No subscriptions, ever.
- All prices are in GBP.
- Digital delivery only — instant download after purchase, no physical
  shipping.
- Full, current catalogue with live pricing: https://kiteestudio.com/shop
- Support / contact: via the site's contact channels linked in the footer
  at https://kiteestudio.com
